Therefore, 15 coconut candles x 2 = 20 lavender candles.
I also understand that if you have 1.5 times as much of one thing as another, you can divide the total amount by 2 to get the amount of the other.

threads.belief: the stated 1.5-times coconut-to-almond relation is read as fixing the per-candle scent amounts (coconut candles use 1.5x scent each), not the total scent quantities
